```{r setup}
#| include: false
library(Seurat)
library(targets)
library(tidyverse)
library(patchwork)
library(cowplot)
library(DT)

source(file.path("src/R/scrna-seq_utilities.R"))

theme_set(theme_cowplot(font_size = 11))

GENE         <- "Mpig6b"
MIN_CELLS    <- 20   # pipeline gene-filter threshold (metadata/project_config.yaml)
cond_pal     <- c(WT = "#888888", `mCh-` = "#2a9d8f", `mCh+` = "#e76f51")
cond_order   <- c("WT", "mCh-", "mCh+")
COMPARTMENTS <- c("HSC", "MNC", "Stroma")
```

```{r helpers}
#| include: false

# ── Extract raw counts for GENE from a Seurat RNA assay ──────────────────────
extract_raw_counts <- function(srt) {
  if (!GENE %in% rownames(srt)) return(NULL)
  vals <- Seurat::GetAssayData(srt, assay = "RNA", layer = "counts")[GENE, ]
  data.frame(cell_id = names(vals), raw_counts = as.numeric(vals))
}

# ── Extract SCT expression for GENE (returns NULL if gene absent) ─────────────
extract_sct_expr <- function(srt) {
  if (!GENE %in% rownames(srt)) return(NULL)
  vals <- Seurat::GetAssayData(srt, assay = "SCT", layer = "data")[GENE, ]
  data.frame(cell_id = names(vals), sct_expr = as.numeric(vals))
}

# ── Derive condition label from sample.name ───────────────────────────────────
label_condition <- function(x) {
  dplyr::case_when(
    grepl("WT",      x) ~ "WT",
    grepl("mCh-",    x) ~ "mCh-",
    grepl("mCh\\+",  x) ~ "mCh+",
    TRUE                 ~ x
  )
}

# ── Detection-rate summary ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
detection_table <- function(df, expr_col = "raw_counts") {
  df %>%
    dplyr::mutate(detected = .data[[expr_col]] > 0) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(compartment, condition, pass_cell) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      n_cells    = dplyr::n(),
      n_detected = sum(detected),
      pct        = round(100 * n_detected / n_cells, 2),
      .groups    = "drop"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(compartment, condition, pass_cell)
}

# ── UMAP scatter coloured by expression ──────────────────────────────────────
umap_expr <- function(df, expr_col, title, pt_size = 0.4, alpha = 0.6) {
  df_ord <- df[order(df[[expr_col]]), ]
  zero   <- df_ord[[expr_col]] == 0
  ggplot() +
    geom_point(data = df_ord[zero,  ],
               aes(UMAP1, UMAP2), colour = "grey85",
               size = pt_size, alpha = alpha) +
    geom_point(data = df_ord[!zero, ],
               aes(UMAP1, UMAP2, colour = .data[[expr_col]]),
               size = pt_size, alpha = alpha) +
    scale_colour_viridis_c(option = "magma", name = expr_col) +
    ggtitle(title) +
    theme(axis.line = element_blank(),
          axis.ticks = element_blank(),
          axis.text = element_blank(),
          axis.title = element_blank(),
          legend.position = "right")
}

# ── Violin + jitter by condition (singlets only) ──────────────────────────────
violin_condition <- function(df, expr_col, title) {
  sing <- df %>%
    dplyr::filter(!dm2_class %in% c("negative", "multiplet")) %>%
    { if ("pass_cell" %in% colnames(.)) dplyr::filter(., pass_cell == TRUE) else . } %>%
    dplyr::mutate(condition = factor(condition, levels = cond_order))
  ggplot(sing, aes(condition, .data[[expr_col]], fill = condition)) +
    geom_violin(scale = "width", trim = TRUE) +
    geom_jitter(width = 0.2, size = 0.3, alpha = 0.3) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = cond_pal, guide = "none") +
    labs(title = title, x = NULL,
         y = if (expr_col == "raw_counts") "Raw UMI counts" else "SCT log-normalised") +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 25, hjust = 1))
}

# ── Violin by cluster (singlets, pass_cell only) ──────────────────────────────
violin_cluster <- function(df, expr_col, title) {
  clust_df <- df %>%
    dplyr::filter(!dm2_class %in% c("negative", "multiplet")) %>%
    { if ("pass_cell" %in% colnames(.)) dplyr::filter(., pass_cell == TRUE) else . } %>%
    dplyr::mutate(cluster = factor(cluster))
  ggplot(clust_df, aes(cluster, .data[[expr_col]], fill = cluster)) +
    geom_violin(scale = "width", trim = TRUE) +
    geom_jitter(width = 0.2, size = 0.3, alpha = 0.3) +
    labs(title = title, x = "Cluster",
         y = if (expr_col == "raw_counts") "Raw UMI counts" else "SCT log-normalised") +
    theme(legend.position = "none",
          axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 25, hjust = 1))
}
```

# Overview

**Gene:** *Mpig6b* (CLEC1B / CLEC-2 receptor; platelet ITAM signalling)

This notebook asks whether *Mpig6b* is detectable in bone-marrow compartments
(HSC, MNC, Stroma) and, if so, whether its expression differs by genotype
condition (WT / Het mCh− / Het mCh+).

Because *Mpig6b* is low-abundance, it may fail the pipeline's `min_cells_per_gene`
filter (threshold = `r MIN_CELLS` cells) and therefore be absent from the
SCTransform-processed objects. We therefore inspect:

1. **Raw counts** (`RNA` assay, pre-QC, pre-gene-filter) — maximum sensitivity.
2. **SCT expression** (processed `DietSeurat`) — confirms presence/absence after
   the gene-filter step and normalisation.

The **pre-QC UMAP** (`mpn_raw_processed_*`) provides a layout for all raw cells;
the **post-QC UMAP** (`mpn_processed_data_*`) is used when SCT expression is
available.

---

# Detection summary — all compartments

```{r detection-summary}
# Load raw objects and anno_raw_meta to build a pooled detection table.
# Each block: load → extract → merge → rm → gc.

build_raw_df <- function(raw_target, raw_meta_target) {
  targets::tar_load_raw(raw_target)
  srt    <- get(raw_target)
  counts <- extract_raw_counts(srt)
  rm(list = raw_target); gc()

  targets::tar_load_raw(raw_meta_target)
  meta <- get(raw_meta_target)
  rm(list = raw_meta_target); gc()

  if (is.null(counts)) return(NULL)
  meta %>%
    dplyr::left_join(counts, by = "cell_id")
}

hsc_raw    <- build_raw_df("mpn_raw_hsc",    "anno_raw_meta_hsc")
mnc_raw    <- build_raw_df("mpn_raw_mnc",    "anno_raw_meta_mnc")
stroma_raw <- build_raw_df("mpn_raw_stroma", "anno_raw_meta_stroma")

# Attach compartment label and cluster + condition columns
prep_df <- function(df, comp) {
  if (is.null(df)) return(NULL)
  clust_col <- grep("sNN_pca.*_res\\.0\\.1$", colnames(df), value = TRUE)[1]
  df %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      compartment = comp,
      condition   = label_condition(sample.name),
      raw_counts  = if ("raw_counts" %in% colnames(.)) raw_counts else 0L,
      cluster     = if (!is.na(clust_col)) .data[[clust_col]] else NA_character_
    )
}

hsc_raw    <- prep_df(hsc_raw,    "HSC")
mnc_raw    <- prep_df(mnc_raw,    "MNC")
stroma_raw <- prep_df(stroma_raw, "Stroma")

all_raw <- dplyr::bind_rows(hsc_raw, mnc_raw, stroma_raw)
```

```{r detection-table}
detection_table(all_raw) %>%
  DT::datatable(
    caption   = paste0(GENE, " detection rate per compartment × condition × QC pass"),
    rownames  = FALSE,
    filter    = "top",
    options   = list(pageLength = 20, scrollY = "360px", scrollCollapse = TRUE)
  )
```

```{r gene-filter-check}
#| results: asis
# Report how many cells (pass_cell == TRUE, singlets) express Mpig6b per compartment
# vs the min_cells_per_gene threshold.
cat("\n**Gene-filter check** (`min_cells_per_gene =", MIN_CELLS, "`):\n\n")
all_raw %>%
  dplyr::filter(pass_cell == TRUE,
                !dm2_class %in% c("negative", "multiplet")) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(compartment) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_singlets  = dplyr::n(),
    n_expressed = sum(raw_counts > 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    passes_filter = dplyr::if_else(n_expressed >= MIN_CELLS, "YES", "NO"),
    label = glue::glue("**{compartment}**: {n_expressed} / {n_singlets} singlets",
                       " express {GENE} → filter: {passes_filter}")
  ) %>%
  dplyr::pull(label) %>%
  paste(collapse = "\n\n") %>%
  cat()
```

# HSC

```{r hsc-load-proc}
#| include: false
# Check if Mpig6b survived into the processed object
targets::tar_load(mpn_processed_data_hsc)
hsc_sct <- extract_sct_expr(mpn_processed_data_hsc)
hsc_in_proc <- !is.null(hsc_sct)

# Post-QC metadata (UMAP + cluster)
hsc_anno <- targets::tar_read(anno_meta_hsc)
rm(mpn_processed_data_hsc); gc()

if (hsc_in_proc) {
  clust_col_proc <- grep("sNN_pca.*_res\\.0\\.1$", colnames(hsc_anno), value = TRUE)[1]
  hsc_proc_df <- hsc_anno %>%
    dplyr::left_join(hsc_sct, by = "cell_id") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      condition = label_condition(sample.name),
      cluster   = if (!is.na(clust_col_proc)) .data[[clust_col_proc]] else NA_character_
    )
}
```

## Raw counts (pre-QC)

```{r hsc-raw-umap}
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 4

clust_col_raw <- grep("sNN_pca.*_res\\.0\\.1$", colnames(hsc_raw), value = TRUE)[1]

p1 <- umap_expr(hsc_raw, "raw_counts",
                paste0(GENE, " — HSC raw counts (all cells)"))
p2 <- ggplot(hsc_raw, aes(UMAP1, UMAP2, colour = pass_cell)) +
  geom_point(size = 0.4, alpha = 0.5) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = "#2a9d8f", `FALSE` = "grey85"),
                      name = "pass_cell") +
  ggtitle("QC pass overlay") +
  theme(axis.line = element_blank(), axis.ticks = element_blank(),
        axis.text = element_blank(), axis.title = element_blank())
p1 | p2
```

```{r hsc-raw-violin-cond}
#| fig-width: 6
#| fig-height: 4
violin_condition(hsc_raw, "raw_counts",
                 paste0(GENE, " by condition — HSC singlets (pass_cell)"))
```

```{r hsc-raw-violin-clust}
#| fig-width: 7
#| fig-height: 4
if (!is.na(clust_col_raw))
  print(violin_cluster(hsc_raw, "raw_counts",
                       paste0(GENE, " by cluster — HSC singlets (pass_cell)")))
```

# Methods

Raw counts were extracted from the `RNA` assay (unfiltered, pre-QC-cell-filter)
of each compartment Seurat object (`mpn_raw_hsc/mnc/stroma`). UMAP coordinates
used for raw visualisations are those from the pre-filter dim-reduction objects
(`mpn_raw_processed_*`), which apply the same PCA → NN-graph → UMAP pipeline as
the final processed objects but without removing low-quality cells.

For SCT expression, the `DietSeurat` objects (`mpn_processed_data_*`) containing
only QC-passing, singlet cells were queried. Any compartment where *Mpig6b* is
absent from the `SCT` assay confirms that the gene was removed by the
`min_cells_per_gene = `r MIN_CELLS`` threshold applied in `pass_gene_*` targets,
or excluded by SCTransform's internal variance filter.

Violin plots are restricted to singlet cells (`dm2_class` ∉ {negative, multiplet})
that pass the cell QC filter (`pass_cell == TRUE`). Cells plotted in grey on UMAP
panels carry zero counts.

{{< include ../_session-info.qmd >}}
